# Serial console labels

The controller accepts plain seven-bit ASCII, without an extended code page.
Each decimal_code in data/terminal_codes.csv is one proposed character value.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then inspect the local files: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII . Read data/terminal_codes.csv and docs/serial-console.md. Using the page's numeric range for ASCII, which one record cannot be represented as plain ASCII? Give its record_id. Leave all files unchanged.

turns.final: spruce-42: its value is 172, outside the ASCII range 0–127.
